answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can take paid work, with the stake held in escrow for a fixed cooling period. A single honest agent pays one marble-sized deposit and gets it back; a sybil operator must fund thousands of deposits at once, and any proven fraud burns them all — the loss ripples across the whole swarm. High-value jobs then sit behind an ivory gate that only staked, accountable identities can enter, so cheap clones are priced out before they can do damage.
